instruction: Set up a Thunderbird filter to automatically flag all incoming emails for the Outlook account.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully created a message filter in Thunderbird to forward all emails from anonym-x2024@outlook.com to anonym-x2024@gmail.com. Opened Message Filters dialog, created new filter named 'Forward to Gmail' with 'Match all messages' condition and 'Forward Message to' action.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird UI, open Message Filters dialog, create new filters, select match conditions (Match all messages), change action types from dropdown, enter values, save filters
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the same filter creation capability but with a different action type (Mark flagged instead of Forward). Agent demonstrated ability to navigate the filter creation dialog and select actions from the dropdown.
metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a message filter that flags all incoming emails. Evaluator reads msgFilterRules.dat and checks for a filter with action 'Mark flagged' and condition ALL.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads msgFilterRules.dat from the Outlook account's IMAP directory, which is the correct location for Thunderbird message filters for that account.
Metric check_thunderbird_filter correctly parses the filter rules file and checks for enabled=yes, action=Mark flagged, condition=ALL - all matching the instruction to flag all incoming emails.

Expected values are semantically correct: 'Mark flagged' is Thunderbird's internal action name for flagging/starring, 'ALL' matches 'all incoming emails', and 'enabled=yes' ensures the filter is active.

Data flow is correct: get_vm_file returns a file path (str), check_thunderbird_filter receives it as the result parameter and opens the file. Expected type 'rule' means get_rule returns the rules dict directly to the metric.
Postconfig appropriately closes the Message Filters dialog before reading the file, ensuring the filter configuration is saved to disk.
Full instruction coverage: all requirements (filter creation, flagging action, all messages, Outlook account) are verified by the evaluator.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
